name: WARNING: Raw Asparagus Stalks & Fibrous Woody Bottoms
whyItWorks: Raw asparagus spears and thick lower woody stems contain dense insoluble lignin and cellulose fibers. When raw, they resist stomach acid and can form an intractable phytobezoar stricture blockage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never eat asparagus raw or crunchy. Snap off and discard tough woody bottoms; only eat tender tips if cooked until completely soft and pureed.
